decoded:
catering quote from Saffron Bites just came
main spread on the 15th Saffron Bites offering two tiers
Tier A is $48 per head and includes the seared tuna canapés, the braised short rib station, and the full dessert display.
Tier B, at $37 per head, swaps the short rib for a mushroom Wellington station and cuts the dessert display down to just the chocolate torte and berry pavlovas.
primary sponsor dinner in the Veridian Room
general attendee reception in the Atrium
^use Tier A primary sponsor dinner
^consider Tier B general attendee reception if budget squeezed
However, their minimum for any single service is 70 guests.
we promised Atrium attendees full experience
^If our final headcount for the Veridian Room is under 70, we'll need to pad it with organizing committee members to hit the minimum
^only move people from the Atrium list if absolutely necessary
^For the Atrium, if the count is between 70 and 90, Tier B is approved.
^If it exceeds 90, switch back to Tier A for them as well, as the per-head cost difference shrinks with volume and the upgrade is worth it for the larger crowd.
^submit final menu selection and guaranteed guest numbers by 5 p.m. this Thursday, the 7th
They've offered a 3% discount if we wire the 50% deposit by Friday at noon instead of the following Monday.
^wire 50% deposit by Friday at noon instead of the following Monday to receive 3% discount
^pay remaining balance on the 13th
^confirm wire details with Aris in Finance and use vendor code CAT-882
^If the discount applies, note it explicitly on the payment authorization.
late-night snack delivery tech crew at 11 p.m. separate order for 15 boxed meals
^double-check proposal includes late-night snack delivery
^exclude separate order per-head calculation
Last year's incident with the pine nut puree cannot be repeated.
Their standard recipe includes it, so this requires a specific amendment.
^Crucially if we go with Tier B anywhere, you must get written confirmation from Saffron Bites that all nut-based ingredients are excluded from the mushroom Wellington filling
